description_excerpt: Job Description Summary The Application Specialist will focus on supporting the clinical training and use of GE MRI systems. The Application Specialist may work individually at an account and as part of a One GE Healthcare team. An Application Specialist for MRI is responsible for supporting customer training for MRI products, and to support the GE MRI business for product and sales support. GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits.
